## Behaviour

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour.

## Validation

Include commands and actual results. Document limitations and missing evidence.

## Release classification

Use a Conventional Commit PR title for squash merge: `fix:` for patch, `feat:` for minor, or `!` / `BREAKING CHANGE:` for an intentional major compatibility change. Documentation-only changes use `docs:`. Reference related issues in the body; do not edit version files or create tags manually. See [automatic releases](../docs/automated-releases.md).
